timing_semantics: Inclusive categories can nest; use exclusive seconds for disjoint observed work. Uninstrumented work and monitor overhead are excluded from category totals. In-flight calls have not entered completed totals.
byte_semantics: Successful numeric invocations across all preview/initialization/live runtimes; repeated speculative work is counted. These are not committed serving bytes.
